nist-location.title: NIST EDA: Measures of Location
nist-location.support: Mean divides the observation sum by its count; median selects the central sorted observation(s); modes can be nonunique.
nist-location.retrieval_method: Retrieved and read using the active agent web tool; support is a paraphrase.

nist-scale.title: NIST EDA: Measures of Scale
nist-scale.support: Ordinary sample variance centers on the observed mean and divides by count minus one. Standard deviation, range, absolute deviations, and IQR have distinct roles. NIST uses N for the observation count; this course uses n for samples.
nist-scale.retrieval_method: Retrieved and read using the active agent web tool; support is a paraphrase.

openstax-events.title: OpenStax Introductory Statistics 2e: Terminology
openstax-events.support: A sample space contains all experiment outcomes; an event selects outcomes. Intersections retain shared outcomes. A symbol choice does not change set membership.
openstax-events.retrieval_method: Retrieved and read using the active agent web tool; support is a paraphrase.

openstax-counting.title: OpenStax College Algebra 2e: Counting Principles
openstax-counting.locator: Multiplication Principle; permutations; combinations; nondistinct objects
openstax-counting.support: Fixed branching counts multiply. Ordered distinct selections use n!/(n-r)!, unordered selections divide by r!, and full arrangements of repeated objects divide n! by multiplicity factorials.
openstax-counting.retrieval_method: Retrieved and read using the active agent web tool; support is a paraphrase.

nist-shape.title: NIST EDA: Measures of Skewness and Kurtosis
nist-shape.locator: Pearson 2 coefficient; Alternative Definition of Kurtosis
nist-shape.support: Mean-minus-median skewness is Pearson second skewness rather than generic moment skewness. Excess kurtosis subtracts three under the stated convention.
nist-shape.retrieval_method: Retrieved and read using the active agent web tool; support is a paraphrase.

fao-grouped.title: FAO Statistical Manual for Forestry Research: Basic Statistics
fao-grouped.locator: Sections 2.2 and 2.3.1, boundaries and grouped center
fao-grouped.support: Class limits and true boundaries differ for rounded measurements. Grouped-median interpolation requires the lower class boundary and width.
fao-grouped.retrieval_method: Retrieved and read using the active agent web tool; support is a paraphrase.

polyu-grouped.title: PolyU Chapter 1: Descriptive Statistics
polyu-grouped.support: Grouped median and mode use true class boundaries and explicit frequency differences.
polyu-grouped.retrieval_method: Active agent retrieved PDF and read formulas and definitions using web tool.
